paras: The silver-eared laughingthrush (Trochalopteron melanostigma) is a species of bird in the family Leiothrichidae. It is found in southern Yunnan, Laos, Myanmar, Thailand and Vietnam.  It was formerly considered a subspecies of the chestnut-crowned laughingthrush, G. erythrocephalus.
